segments.title: January
segments.text: Hello Kenkere House! Happy New Year, team. January is the one month when people walk in already wanting to change. Our theme is Resolutions with Receipts: we help people keep the promise, not just make it.

segments.title: ₹11.8L
segments.text: So, the number. Our January target for Kenkere House is 11.8 lakh rupees. That's 6 per cent above last January. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 6.25 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 4.01 lakh, everything else 82,600, and comebacks 70,800. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 59 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 878 leads, 316 trials, and 59 buyers, with about 19 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.

Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 6.14 lakh rupees, which is 52 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: The 57-Hour Hangover Sale
segments.text: First up, the 57-Hour Hangover Sale. One month unlimited at a flat price, for fifty-seven hours only, with a capped number of memberships. It vanishes faster than everyone's New Year's Eve plans. The plan is 10 buyers at about 10,000, so 1 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Everyone, while the capped stock lasts; one per person.

segments.title: Third Time's the Charm
segments.text: Next, Third Time's the Charm. Three classes for the price of two. The first class is awkward, the second is better, the third, they're hooked. Book class two before they leave class one. The plan is 12 buyers at about 12,400, so 1.49 lakh rupees.

segments.title: U Up? It's 2027.
segments.text: Then, for lapsed members, U Up? It's 2027. Fifteen per cent off to come back, and five bonus days for anyone who hits twelve classes in January. Their mat has been asking about them. The plan is 8 buyers at about 12,400, so 99,200 rupees.
segments.notes: Standard lapsed 15%, bonus earned (≈20% effective if earned)

segments.title: The Baker's Dozen
segments.text: And finally, for our loyal annual members, The Baker's Dozen. Renew your annual and get a thirteenth month, plus privates, guest passes and monthly trainer check-ins. Twelve months is so last year. The plan is 2 buyers at about 1.33 lakh, so 2.66 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, the flash sale opens, and the clock does the selling. Week two, every first-timer books class two before leaving class one. Week three, we personally call every lapsed member on the list. Week four, February expiries get their Baker's Dozen conversation.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's January at Kenkere House. 11.8 lakh rupees, four offers, and 59 buyers to welcome. Resolutions fade by February. Our receipts won't.
